nodes.title: Pavel Holman
nodes.summary: AI engineer and co-founder; leads small teams that ship products; three-time ICPC finalist.
nodes.body:
Pavel Holman is a software engineer in Prague studying for a master's degree in Artificial Intelligence at CTU's Faculty of Electrical Engineering, expected June 2027, after a bachelor's in AI at CTU's Faculty of Information Technology. He co-founded DeelsCorp in 2024 and poqet in 2026 and has been the principal engineer of both: at Deels he led a four-person team across mobile apps, a Kotlin backend, APIs and infrastructure; at poqet he leads a three-person team building SLIM, a lab operations platform, and owns the agentic development tooling around it. He has worked part-time at Merica since 2020 on C# business software, including employee rostering with constraint programming. His bachelor's thesis built an AutoML pipeline forecasting day-ahead and intraday electricity prices from market, weather and grid data. He reached the ICPC Central Europe Regional Contest finals in 2024 and 2025 and the ICPC European Championship finals in 2026.

Strongest skills: TypeScript with Effect, Kotlin, and agentic engineering (Claude Code harnesses, guardrails and evaluations). He prefers practical impact over theory: a working implementation or proof of concept, typed and explicit systems, and claims backed by evidence, which is why this portfolio answers from a knowledge graph with citations. Interests: programming languages (Kotlin, Swift, Rust), functional programming and system design, algorithms, agentic engineering, and neuro-symbolic AI and automated experimentation as areas he is curious about rather than expert in.

Availability: open to remote work and to a thesis-linked research or engineering collaboration alongside the master's degree.

fields.headline: AI engineer and co-founder
fields.lede: AI master's student at CTU and co-founder of two shipped products. I lead small teams end to end, from Kotlin backends and multiplatform apps at Deels to a SvelteKit and Effect lab platform at poqet, with agentic development tooling that keeps both honest. ICPC finalist, three times.

languages.English: professional working proficiency (Cambridge English First, B2)

nodes.title: Agentic engineering
nodes.summary: Claude Code harnesses, guardrails and evals that let a small team ship fast; one of Pavel's three strongest skills.
nodes.body: Building the tooling that makes coding agents reliable: a Claude Code development harness with TypeScript automation, architectural rules and guardrails, and evaluations, so a three-person team can develop SLIM at poqet with agents doing much of the work. The same approach built this portfolio from written specs and ADRs with lint rules and evals as guardrails.

nodes.title: Deels
nodes.summary: Marketplace for gastro discounts, loyalty programmes and surplus food, used by 80 partners in Prague.
nodes.body: Deels is a marketplace connecting gastro businesses and customers in Prague. Businesses reach customers through discounts and loyalty programmes, including discounted food that would otherwise go to waste; customers discover places at lower prices. Used by about 80 gastro partners in Prague. Built by a four-person team led by Pavel Holman: Kotlin backend with PostgreSQL and a GraphQL API, mobile apps in Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform and SwiftUI, services in Docker. Shipped; now in maintenance.

nodes.body: An employee rostering project at Merica: assigning staff to shifts under availability, legal and business constraints, solved with constraint programming and delivered as part of C# business software. Built in a two-person team.

nodes.title: Forecasting energy costs in day-ahead and intraday markets
nodes.summary: Bachelor's thesis: AutoML pipeline forecasting electricity prices from market, weather and grid data.
nodes.body: Bachelor's thesis at CTU FIT (2025). Built an automated, modular electricity-price forecasting pipeline with AutoGluon and pandas, integrating OTE market data, Open-Meteo weather observations and forecasts, and ENTSO-E power-grid data, with cleaning, transformation and merging of multi-source time series. Forecasting tasks: seven-day hourly forecasts for the day-ahead market and one-day forecasts at 15-minute resolution for the intraday market. Compared statistical, machine-learning and deep-learning models against simple baselines using chronological splits and multi-window evaluation; in model selection XGBoost cut day-ahead MAE by about 14% against a daily-average baseline. Noted limitations: weather-forecast availability, a short historical window, and extreme price spikes.

nodes.title: GraphRAG Portfolio
nodes.summary: This site. A 3D resume that answers questions from a knowledge graph and highlights its evidence.
nodes.body: Pavel's personal interactive 3D portfolio: a visitor asks a question or pastes a job description, retrieval selects a subgraph of his professional history, one streamed LLM call answers with inline citations, and the 3D scene highlights the cited nodes as they arrive. Hand-authored Markdown nodes with typed frontmatter are validated and embedded at build time into a committed artifact; the runtime is a stateless Cloudflare Worker. Lint rules forbid `throw` and `Date` in favour of Effect and Temporal.

nodes.summary: Finalist at ICPC CERC 2024, CERC 2025 and the ICPC European Championship 2026; CTU Open problem author.
nodes.body: Competitive programming results: finalist at the ICPC Central Europe Regional Contest (CERC) in December 2024 and December 2025, and finalist at the ICPC European Championship (EUC) in February 2026. Also a problem author for CTU Open, the Czech Technical University's programming contest.

nodes.title: SLIM
nodes.summary: Lab operations platform for academic laboratories; samples, inventory, equipment, notebooks, multi-lab access control.
nodes.body: SLIM is poqet's lab operations platform for academic laboratories in botany, biology and chemistry: sample tracking, inventory and warehouses, projects and tasks, equipment and reservations, lab notebooks and protocols, several laboratories within one institute, and a role- and permission-based access system. Used by research groups at three Prague institutions. Full-stack web application in SvelteKit, Effect and SurrealDB, built by a three-person team led by Pavel Holman.

Backend in Kotlin with PostgreSQL; apps with Kotlin Multiplatform, Compose Multiplatform and SwiftUI; GraphQL API; Docker for services.
